title: notebook
description: The instance's learning notebook written by scripts/notebook.py: short lessons the director keeps between edits, at most 40 of them (the limit is a code rule, not a schema rule, so --limit stays a valid test override). A lesson is a plain lesson or a proposal to move a repeated sentence to a channel.fixed part; the code never writes the config, the owner says yes. The optional waiting array holds lessons a learn pass could not fit; the director never sees them and they are promoted into lessons when room appears. At most 3 lessons wait at a time (a code rule, not a schema rule).
